objective: Extend the cloud System quest model from title/description/status into a backward-compatible Quest v2 lifecycle with structured objectives and progress, deadline metadata, hidden/reveal presentation state, explicit failure/expiry terminal states, and deterministic reconstruction from the same system_events ledger without weakening evidence/reward/idempotency rules.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS and claim-specific live owners own real-world facts/execution; System quest state is derived only.
Neon/PostgreSQL system_events is the sole mutable derived-state owner.
system_apply_action(...) is the shared PostgreSQL mutation gate for HTTP and authorized ChatGPT writes.
Existing quest.created/completed/cancelled events reconstruct ACTIVE/COMPLETED/CANCELLED quests and remain valid historical events.
Scored quest reward amounts are constrained by system-quest-reward:v1; progression requires a verified completion basis and one basis can reward once.
Exact action retries replay and conflicting idempotency-key reuse is rejected.
Northflank PWA reads the same event-derived snapshot and currently renders quest cards.
ChatGPT is the sole intended interactive System controller under skills/system-controller.md.
LifeUp bridge code remains legacy/rollback evidence and is outside the target runtime.
PROTOCOL.md exact live-mutation permission gate remains authoritative; candidate work must not silently mutate production player/schema state.

role_dispositions.destination: Quest progress/completion evidence remains derived and cannot overwrite stronger real-world owners.
All Quest v2 lifecycle changes are append-only events in system_events; no parallel quest store is added.
system_apply_action remains the single public gate but gains validated Quest v2 actions/fields through additive migration 005 while retaining an internal cloned v1 fallback implementation.
Old quest.created events with no v2 fields project exactly as visible objective-free one-shot quests; old complete/cancel semantics remain valid.
Quest v2 does not change system-quest-reward:v1 or progression award amounts/basis rules.
All new actions flow through the existing idempotency contract and append-only ledger.
PWA renders structured objectives/progress/deadline/rewards and suppresses unrevealed hidden quests from normal player presentation; it remains projection-only. XP progress uses level-local progress.
ChatGPT remains sole intended interactive controller and may evaluate deadlines/reveal triggers using authoritative context.
No legacy LifeUp runtime file is required or modified by Quest v2.
Candidate code/tests may be built safely, but promotion/deployment that would auto-apply migration 005 to production requires separate exact Ron authorization.

capability_probes.assertion: A legacy quest.created event with no v2 fields still reconstructs a visible ACTIVE quest and can complete/cancel under the old contract.
A structured Quest v2 cannot transition to COMPLETED while any required objective is below its target.
FAILED/EXPIRED quests cannot later complete and therefore cannot become progression award bases.
Profile calibration, skills, achievements, shop and notification behavior remain unchanged by Quest v2.
Every Quest v2 state is reconstructable from ordered system_events and no mutable side table is introduced.
